COPY THIS LAYOUTBUILD ORDER
  1. 01Make the crop block. Keep the farm plots together along the front and left of the work area.
  2. 02Pack mines in the middle. Use a compact cluster instead of scattering them across the zone.
  3. 03Run machines across the back. Keep production stations in one readable row behind the mine cluster.
  4. 04Push utilities to the edge. Wells and supporting stations stay reachable without cutting the main path.
  5. 05Leave a hauling lane. Preserve the front-to-back route shown by the callout so workers do not weave through every block.
